ads.title: 2a-1 — Borrowed words, the diagnosis
ads.primary_text:
The articles on most advisory sites came from a subscription.

That was a defensible decision. Pre-approved content clears compliance, and for a lot of firms that is the whole reason it is there.

It was compliant. It was also identical, and the same pieces are on hundreds of other firms' sites this week.

Google's published guidelines instruct its evaluators to hold financial content to a higher standard than almost anything else they review. What that standard asks about is whether the person writing has done the work.

A firm's own perspective is the one thing a subscription cannot supply.

The benchmark does not read your articles. It records where your firm lands on the terms people search in your metro, next to the four firms covering the most ground in it.

If the gap is there, that is where it shows up. Ten minutes, and it's yours either way.

Built for RIAs at and beyond $500M in AUM.

ads.on_image_text:

ads.production: Leads the wave: Borrowed words is the diagnosis, marketing engineering answers what fixing it takes. Validates before it diagnoses — 'that was a defensible decision' arrives before anything about sameness, and the sameness line describes the library rather than the buyer. The honesty ceiling is quoted and extended by one clause: Google's published guidelines instruct its evaluators to hold financial content to a higher standard 'than almost anything else they review'. Never 'than almost anything else it ranks', which is a ranking-algorithm claim the ceiling rules unclaimable. No 'penalizes', no invented answer-engine mechanic, no acronyms, and the scaled-content-abuse policy is not invoked. The ad names undifferentiated content as a likely cause and promises to measure the visible symptom; it never offers to read anyone's articles. Plate per G-1: the subject goes on the plate because an image-first reader supplies their own referent for a bare 'it', and 'my firm' supplied makes the line an insult. Four words then four.

Those are different skills, and they only produce something when they fit together.

Performance marketing in this field has moved closer to engineering than to advertising, which is why we call it marketing engineering.

The benchmark is where it starts. Ten minutes on your own market, and it's yours either way.

Built for RIAs at and beyond $500M in AUM.

Plate is two beats, five words then seven, no stat, no card.

Binding deployment condition: the 50% is deployed in T1-S, and 3-2 and T1-S must never run concurrently, because one figure in two live ads makes them read as variants of each other and doubles a single study's weight in the slate.
